# TRAVNY full guide

Source: https://travny.pages.dev/

> Complete machine-readable map of the public TRAVNY hub, related services, stable endpoints and published texts.

## Identity and hosts

- Canonical hub: https://travny.pages.dev/
- Retiring custom domain: https://trfny.com/ — redirects to the canonical Pages host while the domain remains active.
- Legacy Pages host: https://tvpi.pages.dev/ — permanently redirects to the canonical host while preserving path and query.
- Repository: https://github.com/trvny/trvny/tree/main/pages
- TVPI Worker repository: https://github.com/trvny/tvpi
- Creator identity: TRAVNY; aliases trvny, travny, trfny, trafny.
- GitHub identity: https://github.com/trvny ; related organization travnie: https://github.com/travnie
- Project source maps: https://github.com/trvny/trvny ; https://github.com/travnie/twojstar ; https://github.com/trvny/feedseek

The hub is a lightweight static/edge site. It links independent services rather than hiding them behind one application runtime.

## Hub routes

### Home

- Human page: https://travny.pages.dev/
- Markdown representation: https://travny.pages.dev/index.md
- Concise LLM guide: https://travny.pages.dev/llms.txt
- This full guide: https://travny.pages.dev/llms-full.txt

### TVPI

- Human TV page: https://travny.pages.dev/tv/
- Markdown page: https://travny.pages.dev/tv/index.md
- Streaming Worker: https://tvpi.travny.workers.dev/
- Worker overview: https://tvpi.travny.workers.dev/index.md
- Worker LLM guide: https://tvpi.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt
- Worker full guide: https://tvpi.travny.workers.dev/llms-full.txt
- Stable combined playlist: https://tvpi.travny.workers.dev/playlist.m3u
- Raw GitHub playlist fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trvny/tvpi/main/streams/playlist.m3u

TVP upstream stream signatures are short-lived. Consumers should save the stable Worker URLs. Per-channel `.m3u8` endpoints resolve or serve fresh HLS data behind a durable URL.

### Lab

- Workshop: https://travny.pages.dev/lab/

The Astro Lab is an English-language section of the existing Hub with experiments and a notebook of planned follow-ups. It shares the Hub deployment and is not a separate service.

### Papagenerator

- Browser editor: https://travny.pages.dev/papagenerator/
- Source of truth: https://github.com/travnie/twojstar/tree/main/papagenerator

Papagenerator adds meme stickers to local images and exports PNG in the browser. The Pages build publishes a pinned version of its HTML and JavaScript under this route; photos stay in the user's browser.

### Teksty

- Human index: https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/
- Markdown index: https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/index.md
- Tokenowy Mundial AI: https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/token-worldcup/
- GitHubowa Kraina: https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/githubowa-kraina/
- Grass Mud Horse (English / Polish in one article): https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/grass-mud-horse/
- Main Atom feed (articles, CoCzyDziennik and Reactor entries): https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/feed.xml
- CoCzyDziennik issue archive (not a separate feed): https://travny.pages.dev/przeglad/
- GitHubowa Kraina Markdown (region and place descriptions): https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/githubowa-kraina/index.md
- GitHubowa Kraina structured atlas data: https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/githubowa-kraina/atlas.json
- Infrastructure map: https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/githubowa-kraina/universe.html
- Maintained Quarto source: https://github.com/trvny/trvny/blob/main/pages/token-worldcup/token-worldcup.qmd
- Verified generated HTML source: https://github.com/trvny/trvny/blob/main/pages/token-worldcup/token-worldcup.html

TRAVNY publishes the generated Token Cup artifact at build time from `pages/token-worldcup/` rather than maintaining a second copy; the model x effort cost matrix is at https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/token-worldcup/effort-matrix.html. The article compares token counts for equivalent natural text in 27 languages using `o200k_base`; English is the normalized index baseline (`EN = 100`) while the measured English sample is 95 tokens. GitHubowa Kraina is maintained directly in `trvny/trvny` (`pages/site/teksty/githubowa-kraina/`) as an interactive atlas: select a region, then a place for its description and destination. The region catalogue lives in `atlas.json`; its Markdown guide is generated with `node pages/scripts/github-world-guide.mjs`. Repository and service documentation remains authoritative for current details. The Chinese internet slang essay is one bilingual document at `pages/site/teksty/grass-mud-horse/index.html`, with PL / EN switched in-page and one canonical URL. The old Polish path redirects to the same article with `?lang=pl`. The main Atom feed aggregates existing articles from `pages/site/teksty/posts.json`, published CoCzyDziennik issues from Astro `pages/astro/src/content/digests/*.md` and live entries from Reactor JSON Feed. It stores no second copy of digests or editorial notes. `posts.json` is the legacy article catalog, not the complete unified index; the Markdown index is a static guide.

## GitHubowa Kraina: atlas details

Generated from the atlas catalogue. Project documentation is authoritative.

### Feedseek

The observatory for generated and enhanced feeds.

Project: https://github.com/trvny/feedseek

- Feed directory: Browse the published RSS, Atom and JSON feeds. https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/
- Web reader: Read entries from the Feedseek catalogue in a browser. https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/reader/
- Source registry: The configuration that lists feed sources and generators. https://github.com/trvny/feedseek/blob/main/feeds.yaml
- Model feeds: Machine-readable feed output and guidance for agents. https://github.com/trvny/feedseek/blob/main/docs/model-feeds.md

### Kanarek

Android news, widgets and streaming in one app.

Project: https://github.com/travnie/Kanarek

- News reader: Follow RSS and Atom sources, save articles and use offline content. https://github.com/travnie/Kanarek#news
- Home-screen widget: A configurable news slideshow with navigation and source settings. https://github.com/travnie/Kanarek
- Radio and TV: Background radio and IPTV playback with playlists and Cast. https://github.com/travnie/Kanarek
- Optional Worker: An optional Cloudflare backend for fetching and network features. The app can parse feeds directly. https://github.com/travnie/Kanarek

### WAM Bridge

Windows audio crosses the Wi-Fi bridge to Samsung speakers.

Project: https://github.com/travnie/wambridge

- Audio bridge: A local stream and Samsung playback API send audio to supported speakers. https://github.com/travnie/wambridge
- foobar2000 output: A component streams audio playing in foobar2000, including internet radio. https://github.com/travnie/wambridge
- Speaker compatibility: Shape M5 WAM550 was tested; other models remain candidates. https://github.com/travnie/wambridge#speaker-compatibility

### Aistee

An Android-first AI workbench with shared Kotlin Multiplatform logic.

Project: https://github.com/travnie/aistee

- Android app: The first client for a workbench bringing multiple AI providers together. https://github.com/travnie/aistee
- Provider connections: Use native providers and web-based services from one workbench. https://github.com/travnie/aistee
- Shared core: Kotlin Multiplatform hosts shared provider and domain logic. Desktop and iOS are planned. https://github.com/travnie/aistee
- Rolling APK: The current rolling Android build, published by the project. https://github.com/travnie/aistee/releases

### Autka

A car-shopping project spanning Poland, Europe and US imports.

Project: https://github.com/travnie/Autka

- Car shopping: Brings marketplace routes and car-shopping tools together. Reliable licensed listings remain a project constraint. https://github.com/travnie/Autka
- Import calculator: Estimates the cost of bringing a car from the USA to Poland. https://github.com/travnie/Autka
- Android app: The Android-first open-source project and its current development status. https://github.com/travnie/Autka

### TVPI

Stable entry points for TVP IPTV streams.

Project: https://github.com/trvny/tvpi

- TV player: Open the TVP channels from the TRAVNY hub. https://travny.pages.dev/tv/
- Stable playlist: A saveable M3U with Worker endpoints for each channel. https://tvpi.travny.workers.dev/playlist.m3u
- Residential refresh: A Polish home connection can refresh upstream manifests. Continuous availability is not guaranteed. https://github.com/trvny/tvpi

### twojstar workshop

A shared home for tools, utilities and experiments.

Project: https://github.com/travnie/twojstar

- Codebench: Generate, scan and export QR codes and barcodes in the browser. https://codebench.travny.workers.dev/
- Streambench: A local-first workshop for IPTV, radio, playlists and streams. https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/
- Docbench: Work with documents and PDFs locally in the browser. https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/
- Weather Feed: Local weather, air quality and alerts for Kościelec and Chrzanów. https://weather.travny.workers.dev/
- Feedboard: Windows 11 feed widget and settings application. https://github.com/travnie/twojstar/tree/main/feedboard
- Paint.NET plugins: Image tools including ICO and AI Restore plugins. https://github.com/travnie/twojstar/tree/main/paintdotnet
- Audacity plugin: Auto Declip VST3 for audio restoration. https://github.com/travnie/twojstar/tree/main/audacity
- Intent Keyboard: An experiment turning rough intent into natural text. https://github.com/travnie/twojstar/tree/main/intent-keyboard

## Related services

### Weather

- Dashboard: https://weather.travny.workers.dev/
- LLM guide: https://weather.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt
- Full guide: https://weather.travny.workers.dev/llms-full.txt
- Current ensemble JSON: https://weather.travny.workers.dev/state.json
- Weather changes Atom feed: https://weather.travny.workers.dev/feed.atom
- IMGW warnings Atom feed: https://weather.travny.workers.dev/warnings.atom

The service combines multiple sources for Kościelec in Chrzanów and includes temperature, wind, humidity, air quality, pollen and IMGW warnings.

### Feedseek

- Directory: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/
- LLM guide: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/llms.txt
- Full guide: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/llms-full.txt
- Markdown directory: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/index.md
- OPML bundle: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/subscriptions.opml
- Sitemap: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/sitemap.xml
- Source: https://github.com/trvny/feedseek

Feedseek publishes self-updating Atom/RSS feeds, JSON Feed sidecars, OPML and a browser Reader. Its own guides are the source of truth for the current feed inventory and supported WebMCP tools.

### Streambench

- Application: https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/
- Markdown page: https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/index.md
- LLM guide: https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt
- Full guide: https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/llms-full.txt
- Health JSON: https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/health
- Provider manifest: https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/api/providers

Streambench is a local-first IPTV, internet-radio, HLS, M3U/M3U8 and XMLTV workshop. Local files, edits, favorites and history remain in the browser.

### Code Bench

- Application: https://codebench.travny.workers.dev/
- Markdown page: https://codebench.travny.workers.dev/index.md
- LLM guide: https://codebench.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt
- Full guide: https://codebench.travny.workers.dev/llms-full.txt

Code Bench creates, styles, scans and exports QR codes and barcodes. User payloads are processed in browser state.

### Doc Bench

- Application: https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/
- Markdown page: https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/index.md
- LLM guide: https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt
- Full guide: https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/llms-full.txt

Doc Bench edits text and structured documents and performs PDF maintenance locally in the browser. Its own guide documents which WebMCP tools can expose current editor state to an agent.

The sitemap contains public human-facing hub routes. Service-specific machine-readable resources live on their owning service and are linked here rather than duplicated.

## Source-of-truth rules

- `trvny/trvny/pages/` owns the TRAVNY hub; `trvny/tvpi` owns the TVPI streaming Worker.
- Each linked service owns its detailed capability and agent-access documentation in its own `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt`.
- Tokenowy Mundial AI is maintained in `trvny/trvny/pages/token-worldcup/`; the Pages build copies the rendered HTML to the article route.
- GitHubowa Kraina is maintained directly in `trvny/trvny/pages/site/teksty/githubowa-kraina/`.
- Papagenerator is maintained exclusively in `travnie/twojstar/papagenerator/`; the Pages build fetches its pinned release rather than keeping a separate copy.
- Generated or proxied artifacts are not separate maintained sources.


## Agent access

On browser hosts implementing WebMCP, TRAVNY pages with the shared navigation expose `open_travny_destination`. It only starts navigation to destinations already present in the visible TRAVNY menu and does not accept arbitrary URLs.
